description.value: Kami Sushi is a Japanese restaurant situated inside Grandview Corner Mall in Surrey, serving a broad menu of traditional sushi and sashimi alongside inventive specialty rolls like the Angry Jalapeño and Unagi Flame Roll. The restaurant offers lunch and dinner combination plates as well as party trays, making it a potential sit-down meal stop for cyclists passing through South Surrey. Its mall location means covered parking for bikes may be nearby, but this is unconfirmed.
